title: Stale required-context count on dev: CLAUDE.md profile says five, ci.yml header says three; the ruleset has six
description: Found by the LCLI-588 reviewer (opum-ai/lore-cli#280), re-read by the parent session 2026-09-25: rulesets/22838594 (require-ci-on-dev) lists SIX required contexts: docker e2e harness (real lore + backlog binaries), lint · typecheck · test (windows-latest), lint · typecheck · test (ubuntu-latest), Tracker integrity, lore check (docs gate), compile smoke (ubuntu). CLAUDE.md's repository profile ('Constraints and couplings') still says five 'as of 2026-09-15' and omits compile smoke. The header comment of .github/workflows/ci.yml (line ~12) says '3 status checks'. Neither caught it because nothing compares prose to the ruleset. CLAUDE.md is this session's own governing file (tier 2): the owning session decides the edit, not a peer. Better than re-editing both counts: make the prose name no count and point at the gh api query, or add a check that compares the ruleset's contexts with a list the repository keeps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CLAUDE.md profile and the ci.yml header describe the required contexts in a form verified against a live read of ruleset 22838594, with the read date
Either the prose names no hard count, or a check compares it with the ruleset

plan: 1. Live-read ruleset 22838594 and record the context set + date; confirm no test pins either stale count.
2. Rewrite CLAUDE.md's profile paragraph and ci.yml's header to name no hard count, carry the dated set, and point at the gh api query as the source of truth.
3. Gates: bun test and bun run lore check on the pinned runtime; PR into dev.
implementationNotes: IMPLEMENTED on fix/LCLI-590-required-contexts-no-count. LIVE READ 2026-09-29 of ruleset 22838594 (gh api repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/rulesets/22838594): SIX required contexts, in ruleset order -- docker e2e harness (real lore + backlog binaries); lint · typecheck · test (windows-latest); Tracker integrity; lint · typecheck · test (ubuntu-latest); lore check (docs gate); compile smoke (ubuntu). The profile paragraph had said five as of 2026-09-15 and the ci.yml header said 3 read 2026-09-11; the delta is compile smoke plus whatever moved before each read. FIX CHOSEN (AC2's first arm): neither site names a count carried forward. CLAUDE.md now names the query as the source of truth, carries the six as a DATED observation ('read live 2026-09-29'), and says plainly why the count is what goes stale. ci.yml's header points at the ruleset query and says to carry no count or list forward from it. No test pinned either count (grepped test/ for the strings and for ruleset references), so nothing else moved. The second arm (a check comparing prose to the ruleset) was not taken: a machine comparison would need the ruleset read in CI, and the ruleset API needs repository-admin scope the workflow token does not carry; the no-count form removes the drift by construction instead. GATES: bun test 4811 pass / 0 fail / 1 skip (pinned runtime, solo); bun run lore check exit 0; ci.yml parses (YAML.parse) and .quest remains committed.
finalSummary: Both prose sites now name no required-context count: CLAUDE.md's profile points at 'gh api repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/rulesets/22838594' as the source of truth and carries the six contexts as a dated observation (read live 2026-09-29: docker e2e harness, lint·typecheck·test windows-latest, Tracker integrity, lint·typecheck·test ubuntu-latest, lore check (docs gate), compile smoke (ubuntu)); ci.yml's header points at the same query and says no count or list may be carried forward from it. The two stale reads (five as of 2026-09-15, three read 2026-09-11) are named as dated observations, not corrected in place. AC2's second arm was not taken: a machine comparison would need ruleset-admin scope the workflow token lacks, and the no-count form removes the drift by construction. Verified: ruleset read live; no test pinned either count; bun test 4811 pass / 0 fail / 1 skip on the pinned runtime; lore check exit 0; ci.yml parses.
